findings.name: Electrical supply and capacity
findings.action: Demand profile, firm capacity, single-line diagram, power quality, protection and connection study.

findings.name: Production task and duty cycle
findings.action: Production target, route, gradient, payload, state durations, shifts and energy per cycle.

findings.name: Equipment and interface compatibility
findings.action: OEM specifications, power, voltage, connectors, communication and operating limits.

findings.name: Location and civil works
findings.action: Locations, travel distances, space, geotechnical conditions, drainage and construction sequencing.

findings.name: Chilean electrical and commissioning review
findings.action: Identify applicable D.S. 8/RIC requirements and procedures; have a specialist confirm RIC 15 applicability to the specific installation.

findings.name: Chilean mining project and safety review
findings.action: Determine with Sernageomin whether major modifications and associated reviews or approvals apply.

findings.name: Chilean environmental review
findings.action: Compare proposed works with the RCA; assess project categories and material changes under applicable rules.

findings.name: Risks, emergency response and training
findings.action: Risk assessment, high-voltage isolation, emergency response, training and rescue.

findings.name: Trolley segment and mine plan
findings.action: Traffic, gradient, segment life, interfaces, clearance, pantograph and line maintenance.

findings.name: Complete economic assessment
findings.action: Vehicle, works, connection, energy, maintenance and replacement quotations, plus mine life.

findings.name: Procurement and commissioning
findings.action: Equipment and transformer lead times, ownership, intervention windows and acceptance tests.

findings.name: Data and energy management
findings.action: Define meters, boundaries, data quality and sampling; review Chilean energy-management obligations where applicable.
